remarks: Bright & Spacious 3-Level Townhome in Pinewood Estates  Welcome to this 2,000 sq. ft. townhome with 2.5 baths in Pinewood Estates. Offering three levels of comfortable living, this residence is set in a highly convenient location in down town Stamford. The main level features a spacious dining area that flows into an open spacious light filled living room with a fireplace and sliders leading to a deck overlooking the pool. Gleaming hardwood floors run throughout, adding warmth and character to the home. Upstairs, you'll find a generously sized primary bedroom suite with its own balcony, along with a large second bedroom. The finished lower level provides flexible space that can be used as a home office, gym, or den. Ample closet and storage space throughout enhance practicality. Additional highlights include an attached garage, one assigned parking space, and plenty of guest parking. Set in a central location, you'll be close to houses of worship, all downtown amenities including great restaurants, shops, Newfield Shopping Center, and the vibrant Hope Street corridor. Don't miss this opportunity to rent a spacious townhome in one of the most convenient areas of town! Property is being painted and improved new pictures coming soon.
